plugins.name: Google Calendar
plugins.description: Your Google Calendar beside your Claude tabs: the meeting now and next with a countdown and Join, invitations to answer (Accept / Maybe / Decline), today, tomorrow and the next days, reminders with a sound you choose, an event opened as a clean page to discuss with Claude. One account per project through your own OAuth client (the panel walks you through it). It changes nothing in Google Calendar but your answers to invitations. Provides the agenda slot for Inbox 0.2.0 (needs cc-cockpit 0.10.0). Needs cc-cockpit 0.9.4 or later; 0.9.5 for reminder sounds and Join.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Google Chat
plugins.description: Your Google Chat in lanes (Mentions, Direct messages, Spaces, Alerts, Recent) for a Google Workspace account, one account per project through your own OAuth client (the panel walks you through it). Mark read and unread; open a conversation as a clean page to discuss with Claude. Sorted by Jev triage when installed. It changes nothing in Google Chat but your read state. Feeds Inbox 0.2.0 (inbox feed version 2). Needs cc-cockpit 0.9.2 or later; 0.10.0 for Inbox 0.2.0 and the overlay toolbar buttons.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Gmail
plugins.description: Your Gmail in lanes (Unread, Alerts with Grafana grouping, Read), one Google account per project through your own OAuth client (the panel walks you through it). Open a thread as a clean page to discuss with Claude; with the Jira plugin, a mail from Jira shows its issue beside it. Sorted by Jev triage when installed. It only ever changes the read state: it never archives, labels, trashes or sends. Feeds Inbox 0.2.0 (inbox feed version 2). Needs cc-cockpit 0.9.1 or later (0.9.2 recommended); 0.10.0 for Inbox 0.2.0 and the overlay toolbar buttons.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Inbox
plugins.description: One list of what needs you across Chat, Mail and Jira (any plugin that offers an inbox feed, version 2), placed in groups by your own rules (Jev questions included), with done, snooze, undo and search, and Calendar's agenda in a slot. Rules are global, or a project keeps its own set (work and personal projects apart). It reads the other plugins through their services and has no account of its own. Needs cc-cockpit 0.10.0, and Chat 0.3.0, Gmail 0.5.0, Jira 0.7.0 or Calendar 0.3.0 as sources.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Jev triage
plugins.description: Requires the Jev plugin (bronos.jev). The "triage" plugin service for source plugins (mail, Jira, chat): a priority (urgent, action, fyi, noise) and a kind per item, judged by Jev, with per-project rules, a profile of what you own, your corrections, and an improve loop that turns a wrong verdict into a better rule or profile in a Claude tab.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Jev
plugins.description: Jev, TypeSafe's cheap typed classifier, as the "jev" plugin service: other plugins ask choice, yes/no and score questions (one request, or a grid over many items). OpenRouter, TypeSafe direct or a custom endpoint; default model typesafe/jev-1.14; usage counted per calling plugin, with a monthly spending cap. Choices only, no free-form text generation.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Jira
plugins.description: Your Jira Cloud issues in lanes (Backlog, In progress, Mentioned, On hold, Done) with unread marks, read-only towards Jira. Open an issue as a styled page to discuss with Claude. Sorted by Jev triage when installed. Provides the jira service (issue status and view) to other plugins such as Gmail, and feeds Inbox 0.2.0 (inbox feed version 2). Needs cc-cockpit 0.8.0 or later; 0.10.0 for Inbox 0.2.0 and the overlay toolbar buttons.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Example
plugins.description: A click counter to copy as a starting point for your own plugin. One panel, one setting, one command.
